title: [M1] `mergeyard init` and `mergeyard repo add`

body:
Blocked by: #2

### Context
PRD §7 (GitHub contract), §8 (eligibility).

### Scope
Thin wrapper over `gh`, with JSON output parsed into typed structs:
- list open issues for a repository with labels, creation time, and body;
- read unresolved blockers from GitHub's native issue dependencies (`issue_dependencies_summary.blocked_by` / the dependencies endpoints);
- add / remove labels;
- read a single issue's state;
- `github.*` error codes, bounded retry with backoff for transient failures (§22).

Untrusted issue text is never passed through a shell (§32).

### Acceptance criteria
- Unit tests with recorded `gh` JSON fixtures, including issues with open and closed blockers.
- An integration test (opt-in, against a dedicated test repository) lists issues, reads blockers, and adds/removes a label.
title: [M1] GitHub adapter: issues, blockers, labels
